verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.notte.cc/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a dedicated 'Critical Instructions For AI Agents' section that routes agents to quickstart.md. The docs are served as raw .md pages and include agent-directed guidance, such as requiring element IDs to come from live observe() output, plus agent-integration guides for Claude Code, CrewAI and the Vercel AI SDK. Missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt bundle, and no independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs.
